scenes.title: Under the hood
scenes.vo: Here's how it works under the hood.

scenes.title: REASON / EXECUTE
scenes.vo: One brief, two brains. REASON — Gemini on Vertex AI, through Google Cloud Agent Builder — emits a schema-validated plan. No tool loop, deterministic. EXECUTE — a FastAPI gateway — drives real GitLab calls.

scenes.title: MongoDB MCP — the memory
scenes.vo: Memory is MongoDB — spoken to through the official MongoDB MCP server. Every plan grounds live: rank-fusion merges vector search over Voyage embeddings with full-text search. Code retrieval goes further: each gate searches its own lane, matches on AI-written file summaries, and expands one hop along the import graph — a match brings its whole dependency cluster.

scenes.title: Ratify
scenes.vo: The plan enters a relay. Each gate offers three contracts: reuse — pulled straight from memory — fresh, or write your own. A human ratifies every gate. One gate, one owner.

scenes.title: Verify
scenes.vo: Ratification dispatches real GitLab work. Merges flow back: each one flips the tester's acceptance checklist from awaiting to ready — and interface contracts are verified against what actually shipped.

scenes.title: Compound
scenes.vo: Then it compounds. Shipped projects and ratified decisions write back through the same MCP into memory. Every merge bumps the owner's passport — per-skill trust. The next brief starts smarter.

scenes.title: Close
scenes.vo: Memory, ratify, verify, compound. One loop — on Gemini, Google Cloud, and the MongoDB MCP.
